title: iEEG networks preprocessing study (Shi, Pattnaik et al. 2024; HUP + MUSC): functional-connectivity networks for 2 re-referencing x 24 connectivity pipelines (derivative)
description: A derivative BIDS-iEEG dataset of functional-connectivity networks computed from interictal intracranial EEG of 148 epilepsy patients at HUP and MUSC. Networks cover two re-referencing schemes (common average and bipolar) crossed with 24 connectivity measures, including correlation, coherence, phase-locking value and relative entropy across frequency bands. It accompanies a study of how re-referencing and connectivity choice affect the utility of iEEG networks. It contains no time series; raw recordings are hosted on iEEG.org.
methods_description: Two-minute interictal iEEG epochs (up to five per patient) were re-referenced (common average, bipolar) and used to compute 24 connectivity measures (Pearson, squared Pearson, cross-correlation, coherence, phase-locking value, relative entropy in delta to ripple and broadband bands) with the CNT_Preprocessing_Toolkit. Networks are stored as MAT files with JSON sidecars for grey/white matter and left/right channel sets.
